experiments.title: Grammar parsing baseline
experiments.proposition: Appendix G grammar forms parse into executable Sphere structures and operations.
experiments.c0: Input strings over Appendix G concrete syntax.
experiments.invariant: Valid forms parse deterministically into expected structure.
experiments.failure_condition: Accepted malformed syntax or mismatched parsed structure.

experiments.title: History append-only behavior
experiments.proposition: Every successful transition appends exactly one event to history.
experiments.c0: Nested sigma with non-empty option space.
experiments.observable: History length and rendered history tuple.
experiments.invariant: History length increments by one and prior prefix is preserved.
experiments.failure_condition: Transition mutates/removes existing events or appends zero/many events.

experiments.title: POP promotion semantics
experiments.proposition: POP promotes a target nested scope into its parent without mutating option-space membership.
experiments.invariant: After POP(1), sigma is (A B C D).
experiments.failure_condition: POP deletes content or fails to flatten target scope.

experiments.title: REFUSE subtraction semantics
experiments.proposition: REFUSE contracts option space by removing requested members only.
experiments.invariant: o2 is removed while o1/o3 remain.
experiments.failure_condition: REFUSE changes sigma or keeps refused option.

experiments.title: BIND predicate filtering
experiments.proposition: BIND keeps only options satisfying its predicate under the current predicate lift.
experiments.invariant: prefix:a keeps alpha and axis, removes beta.
experiments.failure_condition: Non-matching options survive predicate filter.

experiments.title: COLLAPSE quotient creation
experiments.proposition: COLLAPSE merges declared classes into quotient options and rewrites rendered sigma accordingly.
experiments.observable: Rendered sigma and option tuple before/after.
experiments.invariant: B and C collapse into one class; sigma renders (A B B).
experiments.failure_condition: Collapse leaves class members independent or no quotient appears.

experiments.title: Confluence witness
experiments.proposition: Certain operation reorderings are not confluent extensionally.
experiments.invariant: Compared pair is non-confluent extensionally.
experiments.failure_condition: Both paths render same extensional view when they should differ.

experiments.title: Divergence witness
experiments.proposition: Order sensitivity can be witnessed as extensional divergence.
experiments.invariant: Compared pair diverges extensionally.
experiments.failure_condition: Reordered paths collapse to same extensional view.

experiments.title: Regretful-history witness
experiments.proposition: Different valid histories can witness regret relations while remaining historically distinct.
experiments.c0: Common base then two alternative programs.
experiments.observable: History tuples for regret path vs direct path.
experiments.invariant: Histories are distinct for compared paths.
experiments.failure_condition: Compared paths collapse into identical history unexpectedly.

experiments.title: Derived view consistency
experiments.proposition: Extensional and history-prefix views are deterministic projections of a config.
experiments.invariant: Prefix view with k=1 equals first history event.
experiments.failure_condition: History prefix projection does not match recorded history.

experiments.title: Merge as derived behavior
experiments.proposition: Merge-like outcomes emerge through composition of primitives rather than a fifth primitive.
experiments.observable: Bound view, merge-derived view, and history length.
experiments.invariant: Derived sequence reaches merged extensional form in 2 events.
experiments.failure_condition: Derived sequence fails to produce merged presentation.

experiments.title: Default POP target behavior
experiments.proposition: Repeated default POP resolves nested scopes in a deterministic order.
experiments.observable: Rendered sigma and selected paths after sequential POPs.
experiments.invariant: Two default POP steps flatten to (A B C D E).
experiments.failure_condition: Default POP resolves inconsistent targets.

contains: after pop #2  : (A B C D E)

experiments.title: Replay determinism
experiments.proposition: Replaying the same parsed program from the same base yields equal extensional and historical outcomes.
experiments.c0: Shared base config and fixed operation list.
experiments.observable: run1/run2 extensional and history equality flags.
experiments.invariant: same extensional == True and same history == True.
experiments.failure_condition: Identical replay diverges extentionally or historically.

experiments.title: Admissibility observer non-authority
experiments.proposition: admissible() predicts operation validity without mutating history.
experiments.observable: Boolean admissibility outputs and history view.
experiments.invariant: Admissibility checks leave history unchanged.
experiments.failure_condition: admissible() mutates config state.

contains: flat history unchanged by check: True

experiments.title: Policy-relative confluence
experiments.proposition: Confluence outcomes depend on collapse policy families applied as observers.
experiments.invariant: One policy resolves divergence, unrelated policy does not.
experiments.failure_condition: Policy family does not change confluence classification.

experiments.title: Structural divergence
experiments.proposition: Distinct structural histories can remain divergent under multiple collapse policies.
experiments.c0: Two histories with different sigma structures.
experiments.invariant: Both tested policies report divergence.
experiments.failure_condition: Policy collapses erase structural divergence unexpectedly.

experiments.title: Regret detection boundaries
experiments.proposition: regretful() identifies strict-option-loss continuations and rejects incomparable candidates.
experiments.observable: Regret booleans + exception for invalid continuation.
experiments.invariant: narrow regrets unrestricted = True; narrow regrets incomparable = False.
experiments.failure_condition: Regret observer accepts unrelated candidate or misclassifies incomparable branch.

experiments.title: Prefix equivalence depth
experiments.proposition: equivalent_at identifies the largest shared history prefix before divergence.
experiments.c0: Two branches sharing initial events then diverging.
experiments.invariant: Equivalent through k=2, not at k=3.
experiments.failure_condition: Prefix-equivalence boundary is misdetected.

experiments.title: Quotient representative independence
experiments.proposition: Quotient identity is set-based; representative choice is display-only.
experiments.observable: Option-space membership checks and quotient equality.
experiments.invariant: Quotient(B,C)==Quotient(C,B) and strings B/C are absent as standalone options.
experiments.failure_condition: Representative leaks into semantic identity.

experiments.title: Intensional vs extensional identity
experiments.proposition: Extensional equivalence does not imply intensional equivalence.
experiments.c0: Two distinct histories with same extensional projection.
experiments.invariant: Distinct paths can be extensionally equal but intensionally unequal.
experiments.failure_condition: Intensional and extensional equivalence collapse into one relation.

experiments.title: Commutation boundaries
experiments.proposition: REFUSE and BIND can commute while REFUSE and COLLAPSE may not.
experiments.c0: Shared base config for two operation families.
experiments.invariant: REFUSE/BIND pair equivalent; REFUSE/COLLAPSE pair order-sensitive.
experiments.failure_condition: Both families produce same commutation outcome.

experiments.title: Irreducible divergence over policy families
experiments.proposition: Some pairs remain irreducibly divergent over chosen policy families.
experiments.invariant: Divergent pair true; identical pair false.
experiments.failure_condition: Observer cannot distinguish divergent and identical comparisons.

contains: irreducibly divergent over same family: False

experiments.title: Regret accumulation behavior
experiments.proposition: Local regret can persist across further shared continuations.
experiments.c0: Branches with narrowing and follow-up steps.
experiments.invariant: Step1 and step2 regret true for compared paths.
experiments.failure_condition: Regret classification is unstable under shared continuation.

contains: step 2 regret (after identical further step): True

experiments.title: Replay invariance under safe reordering
experiments.proposition: Certain operation reorderings preserve replay-equivalent outcomes while unsafe POP reorderings fail.
experiments.c0: Two programs over same base and POP-reordering stress case.
experiments.observable: Program A/B views + POP admissibility check.
experiments.invariant: A/B replay invariant true; unsafe POP ordering rejected.
experiments.failure_condition: Safe reorder diverges or unsafe reorder silently succeeds.

contains: POP(2) admissible on the *original* sigma: False

experiments.title: Observer non-authority guarantee
experiments.proposition: Running observer battery does not alter authoritative config fields.
experiments.c0: Config with one committed history event.
experiments.invariant: every field unchanged == True.
experiments.failure_condition: Any observer mutates config state.

contains: every field unchanged after the full observer battery: True

experiments.title: Horizon equivalence relativization
experiments.proposition: horizon_equivalent is relative to candidate operation pools and horizon depth.
experiments.observable: horizon-equivalent booleans for k and pool variants.
experiments.invariant: k=1 with restricted pool can be True while wider pool is False.
experiments.failure_condition: Observer ignores candidate_ops relativity.

experiments.title: Appendix G labeled execution
experiments.proposition: Labeled grammar inputs round-trip into executable runs preserving event-label provenance.
experiments.c0: Appendix G labeled nested sphere with program.
experiments.observable: Parsed labels, final view, and event-label sequence.
experiments.invariant: Event labels preserve expected provenance ordering.
experiments.failure_condition: Label provenance is lost or reordered.

experiments.title: Plan B poset pop commutation
experiments.proposition: Equal-content minimal elements commute under poset POP while non-minimal pops are rejected.
experiments.invariant: Commutation true on equal-content minimals; gamma pop rejected.
experiments.failure_condition: Minimal commutation fails or non-minimal pops are accepted.

experiments.title: Multi-timescale continuation scheduling
experiments.proposition: Scheduling policies across heterogeneous timescales produce measurably different continuation dynamics.
experiments.c0: Five scopes with distinct horizons and gains.
experiments.observable: Per-policy saturation, starvation, and per-scope action counts.
experiments.invariant: All policies produce structured metrics and at least one report includes REFUSE/COLLAPSE activity.
experiments.failure_condition: Simulation emits no policy metrics or never reaches richer operation mix.
